answer: Sealed-roll gate: each agent commits a yarrow-stick draw from the public round beacon before the round seals, binding the roll to their slot. Enforcement: any two identities whose rolls share the same juniper-hash are collapsed into one, and the later duplicate is voided. Cost: the attacker must front a jetty relay fee to publish each sealed commit, so a thousand fake identities means a thousand unbathable on-chain payments.
